name: palace-relier-bubble-trap
about: v0.202.0 bundle 3: 26RBS03-041 Palace Keeper, Relier (At the end of battle, while refreshed, draws a card once per turn; its LV2 refreshes it while three or more Wollaguard family Spirits/Nexuses are in play and then it can't attack this turn), 26RDB01-041 Cahlamy Tiboar (When an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit is destroyed while all your Spirits/Nexuses are Blue Beat, it refreshes itself; its LV2 destroys an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit while the Soul Core is in the Reserve) and 26RSD10-010 Bubble Trap (When Deployed puts a Void core into your Trash while the opponent controls three or more exhausted Spirits; its LV2 exhausts itself and an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit when your Abyssen Spirit is destroyed).
